honor_graduate.intro: For the class of 2028 and younger, graduating as an Honor Graduate takes all three of these:
requirements: 2 years (2 credits) of the same foreign language
A Diploma of Merit or a Diploma of Distinction

diplomas.name: Diploma of Distinction
step2: Earn a technical certificate (for example, an associate's degree or the Practical Nursing program)
Earn a Certificate of General Studies

other_pathways.name: Early Postsecondary (General Bachelor's Degree Program)
other_pathways.summary: Take three core college classes, one at each level.
other_pathways.merit: Earn 12 college credit hours (3 core classes plus 1 more).
other_pathways.distinction: Earn a technical degree (associate's degree) or a Certificate of General Studies.

other_pathways.name: Advanced Placement (AP)
other_pathways.summary: Take any three AP classes, one at each level.
other_pathways.merit: AP Scholar (a 3 or better on at least 3 AP exams), or AP Scholar with Honor (an average of at least 3.25 on all AP exams, and a 3 or better on at least 3 of them).
other_pathways.distinction: AP Scholar with Distinction (an average of at least 3.5 on all AP exams, and a 3 or better on 5 or more of them).

words.definition: A set of three classes in one subject, taken in order (Level 1, Level 2, Level 3).
Jobs that employers need lots of people for and that pay well. Only H2 CTE pathways count toward the Diploma of Merit, Diploma of Distinction, and Honor Graduate.
Career and Technical Education: classes that teach hands-on skills for a specific career.
A class that earns high school credit and college credit at the same time.
A test of job skills like reading, math, and finding information. Platinum is the highest score level.
An award on your diploma for being able to read, write, and speak well in two languages.
Northwest Technical Institute and NorthWest Arkansas Community College. Some pathway classes are taught through them, and you need test scores and an application to get in.
